package cli

import (
	"bytes"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	posemodel "github.com/harne8/pose-mcp/internal/pose"
)

func zzGit(t *testing.T, root string, args ...string) string {
	out, _ := exec.Command("git", append([]string{"-C", root, "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@t"}, args...)...).CombinedOutput()
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(out))
}

func zzScope(t *testing.T, name, root, base, head string) {
	sel, err := computeChangedScopeWith(root, base, head, nil, scopeMetadata{})
	t.Logf("%s [%s %s]: changed=%v err=%v", name, base, head, sel.Changed, err)
}

func zzNote(t *testing.T, root string, args ...string) {
	var so, se bytes.Buffer
	code := cmdReport(root, append([]string{"--task", "probe"}, args...), &so, &se)
	raw, _ := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSpace(so.String()))
	s := string(raw)
	if i := strings.Index(s, "## Files Changed"); i >= 0 {
		s = s[i:strings.Index(s, "## Validation Commands")]
	}
	t.Logf("report %v exit=%d stderr=%q MD=%q", args, code, se.String(), s)
}

func TestZZRevs(t *testing.T) {
	root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, "b.txt"), []byte("b\n"), 0o644)
	zzGit(t, root, "add", "b.txt")
	zzGit(t, root, "commit", "-q", "-m", "b")
	tree := zzGit(t, root, "rev-parse", "HEAD~1^{tree}")
	for _, base := range []string{"4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904", tree, "HEAD^-", "HEAD~1", "HEAD~1..HEAD", "HEAD~1...", "nope"} {
		_, perr := posemodel.RawGit("-C", root, "diff", "--name-only", base, "--").Output()
		t.Logf("plain git diff %s ok=%v", base, perr == nil)
		zzScope(t, "rev", root, base, "")
	}
	zzScope(t, "tree head", root, "4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904", "HEAD")
}

func TestZZRepoFailures(t *testing.T) {
	root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "config"), []byte("[core\n"), 0o644)
	zzScope(t, "broken config", root, "HEAD", "")
	zzNote(t, root)
	zzNote(t, root, "--since", "HEAD")
	outside := t.TempDir()
	t.Setenv("GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES", filepath.Dir(outside))
	zzScope(t, "outside", outside, "HEAD", "")
	other, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
	t.Setenv("GIT_TEST_ASSUME_DIFFERENT_OWNER", "1")
	t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL", os.DevNull)
	t.Setenv("GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM", "1")
	zzScope(t, "dubious ownership", other, "HEAD", "")
	zzNote(t, other)
}

func TestZZLongWarning(t *testing.T) {
	root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
	zzGit(t, root, "config", "diff.dirstat", strings.Repeat("bogusparameter,", 60))
	os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index"), []byte(strings.Repeat("g", 200)), 0o644)
	zzScope(t, "long warning", root, "HEAD", "")
	zzNote(t, root)
}

func TestZZPaths(t *testing.T) {
	root, _ := staleIndexRepo(t)
	os.MkdirAll(filepath.Join(root, "sub"), 0o755)
	os.Chmod(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index"), 0)
	zzNote(t, filepath.Join(root, "sub"), "--since", "HEAD")
	os.Chmod(filepath.Join(root, ".git", "index"), 0o644)
	wt := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "wt")
	zzGit(t, root, "worktree", "add", "-q", wt)
	idx := zzGit(t, wt, "rev-parse", "--git-path", "index")
	os.Chmod(idx, 0)
	zzNote(t, wt, "--since", "HEAD")
	zzNote(t, wt)
}
